title: Austin's Closed-Door City Manager Talks
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   Austin officials held a special meeting behind closed doors.
*   The entire session was dedicated to discussing candidates for the new City Manager position.
*   The meeting included a recess, allowing the Housing and Planning Committee to convene for its own session.
*   No public votes or policy decisions were made during this special meeting.
